messages:
Zoe Patel: Hey team — my USB-C dock arrived but my Rode USB mic isn't showing up in macOS Sound prefs. Also the monitor arm box is missing from the shipment. Anyone know who handles hardware swaps?

Lina (IT): @Zoe Patel sorry about that. For the mic can you: 1) unplug the dock from laptop, 2) connect the mic directly to laptop USB-A or adapter, 3) check System Report > USB to see if it's enumerated? If it's not visible likely a faulty hub. Quick log command: ioreg -p IOUSB -l | grep -i rode

Zoe Patel: I ran that and nothing shows for Rode. Plugging the mic directly works — so it's the dock. Monitor arm box definitely missing. Tracking shows 'delivered to front desk' but nothing there. @Ryan (Shipping) can you check?

Ryan (Shipping): Hey @Zoe — can you DM me the tracking number? I'll ping the courier and facilities. If the dock is DOA we'll schedule a replacement drop-off. Can do same-day in SF office.

Lina (IT): For replacement flow I can drop a loaner dock from our stash. If you want a full swap we'll put a return label on the old one. Quick question — are you able to connect external headphones to the dock's 3.5mm jack? If yes, can you test audio passthrough with headphones?

Zoe Patel: Headphones work through the dock. So only USB device passthrough fails. Happy to take a loaner while Ryan sorts the monitor. Thanks!

Ryan (Shipping): update: Facilities confirmed front desk has a package with a monitor arm label but it was filed under 'services' shelf. I'll bring it to you. Sending you a FedEx pickup for the faulty dock; pickup scheduled tomorrow 3–5pm. Tracking: https://fedex.com/track/FX123456789

Lina (IT): Sweet. I scheduled a loaner drop-off for today 4:30pm (Slack PM'll have the locker code). When you hand the faulty dock to the courier please include serial on the sticker; our returns system needs it. If anything weird after swap ping me and I'll open a hardware ticket.

Zoe Patel: Perfect — thank you both! @it-bot I've closed the onboarding checklist item 'dock/hardware' — marking resolved for now :white_check_mark:

it-bot: Onboarding checklist updated for @Zoe Patel — items changed: dock/hardware -> In progress -> Returned: loaner in use. (automated)

Alex Chen: Welcome Zoe! If you want, swing by 3rd floor 3pm for a quick intro to the infra team. No pressure.

Zoe Patel: I'll be there, thanks Alex :)
